patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Frame: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.. Choose Magento only if your buying job matches “Open-source Magento core (free) plus Adobe Commerce enterprise licenses (GMV quote) — deep” rather than Sellfy's shape. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than Magento's shape. Workflow advantage: Magento leans online-storefront, catalog-management; Sellfy leans online-store, digital-products. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Magento is Open-source Magento core (free) plus Adobe Commerce enterprise licenses (GMV quote) — deep catalog/B2B with high hosting and agency TCO.; Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce..
- Company-size focus: Magento (mid-market, enterprise) vs Sellfy (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Magento-leaning online-storefront, catalog-management, wholesale-b2b vs Sellfy-leaning online-store, digital-products.
- Researched limits: Magento — Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0; Sellfy — none listed.

Limitations — Magento: Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0; Adobe Commerce pricing is opaque (GMV quote) — hard to compare without a partner worksheet; Sellfy: —.

Poor-fit cases: Magento is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Operational and agency TCO is high versus hosted SaaS even when the Open Source license is $0 · Avoid Magento if you actually need Sellfy's motion (Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner i) · Avoid Sellfy if you actually need Magento's motion (Open-source Magento core (free) plus Adobe Commerce enterprise licenses (GMV quo)
